links.outcome: Authenticity of references cited by generative AI in answers to spine guideline questions
links.effect: Of 254 references generated, 76.0% (n=193) were authentic and 24.0% (n=61) were fabricated. Claude cited more authentic peer-reviewed papers (91.0%) than Gemini (50.7%), p<.001.
links.quote: Both tools generated 254 references to support their responses, of which 76.0% (n=193) were authentic and 24.0% (n=61) were fabricated.

screen.reason: Evaluates the alignment of two LLMs (Claude and Gemini) with spine guidelines and assesses hallucination rates in cited references, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
